newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Want Want shares fall on Taiwan news.
newsitem.headline: Want Want shares fall on Taiwan news.

text.p: The share price of Taiwan snack maker Want Want Holdings Ltd fell in late Singapore trading on Wednesday following news that Taiwan plans to clamp down on China investment, dealers said.
At 0800 GMT, the price of stocks in the rice cracker company was down US$0.25 at US$2.95 on volume of 270,000 shares.
"The Taiwan news has dampened stocks like Want Want which depends a lot on China," said a broker with a local bank.
Taiwan's Economics Ministry said Taiwan firms must not begin any projects in China without authorisation from its investment commission.
Want Want has several factories in China, which also accounts for the bulk of the group's turnover and pre-tax profit.
However, some analysts said the news from Taipei was unlikely to have any impact on the company.
"The company is listed and incorporated in Singapore and in that sense, protected," an analyst with a European institution said. "It's sentiment-drivened. Fundamentally, the stock looks good."
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
